family: RMTO Publication 102 nominal PSC inverted-T girders (Iran)

source.title: RMTO Publication 102, typical bridge deck drawings to 20 m span
source.acquisition: Previously acquired mirror via picofile generateDownloadLink; not a newly verified official RMTO download.
source.classification_evidence: PDF p6 explicitly specifies WIRE, STRAND and PRETENSIONING. Selected sheets distinguish open prestressing strand circles from filled reinforcing bars. The document also includes ordinary RC.
source.current_status: Official version and current applicability unverified.

scope: Eight-vertex nominal bare girder at the dimensioned underside-of-slab interface. Excludes 180 mm CIP slab, permanent formwork, reinforcement and end blocks; no undocumented chamfers/fillets.
property_note: No bare A/cy/I table identified; visible schedules are material/reinforcement quantities. Tests use independent rectangle/triangle mechanics, not published targets.

withheld.reason: Upper width chain absent; do not inherit a 200 mm web from adjacent sheets without corroboration.

residual_families: Other PSC slab, spaced-girder and small culvert/joist sections remain untranscribed; no claim of complete Iranian catalogue coverage.
